A1.justification: Both 18-page PDFs describe the same DM-Calib research and include supplementary Sections 6–7. Text, embedded-content, and rendered-page comparisons establish complete correspondence of the scientific material; differences are confined to version markings and metadata.

before.justification: v2 reports original calibration, depth estimation, metrology, reconstruction, and ablation results in Section 4 and supplementary Section 7.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including the calibration and depth comparisons in Tables 1–2 and supplementary results in Tables 8–14.

M1.justification: The Camera Image representation, diffusion model, RANSAC recovery, and downstream depth and reconstruction procedures are identical in Sections 3 and 6.

E1.justification: Training and evaluation datasets, task coverage, and test scenarios are identical, including the datasets in Tables 6–7 and supplementary metrology and reconstruction scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in each corresponding experiment, including both DiffCalib variants in Table 1, the depth baselines in Tables 2 and 9, and comparisons with and without intrinsic cues.

E3.justification: Sampling, preprocessing, training budgets, evaluation metrics, alignment procedures, and test-time ensembling settings are unchanged in Sections 4.1, 6, and 7.9.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same representation/noise and depth ablations, reduced-training-data comparison, principal-point analysis, ensembling analysis, and metrology/reconstruction case studies.

E5.justification: Section 7.9 retains averaging five predicted camera images, and Tables 13–14 retain identical standard-deviation reporting with and without ensembling. No run-count, seed, or uncertainty-reporting information changes.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings are identical across the main text and supplement. For example, Table 1 retains average focal-length and principal-point errors of 0.078 and 0.017.

T1.justification: The Camera Image definition, equations (1)–(6), and supplementary Procrustes alignment formulation are identical. No mathematical assumption, derivation, or formal result changes.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain identical claims about Camera Image, monocular calibration, generalization, and benefits to downstream 3D tasks.

C2.justification: The explanations concerning diffusion priors and representation compatibility, interpretations of downstream results, and qualifications concerning ultra-wide-angle images and inference efficiency are unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, preprocessing instructions, hardware, training time, and the code-access link are unchanged, including the supplementary disclosures in Section 6.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and all 96 numbered reference entries are identical. No cited work or substantive research-positioning statement is added, removed, or revised.

P1.justification: The first-page stamp changes from v2 dated 16 Jul 2025 to v3 dated 18 Sep 2025. PDF author metadata changes 'Xiaoxiao-Long' to 'Xiao-Xiao Long'; the printed author list, prose, terminology, and section structure remain identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–15, Tables 1–14, their captions, and the body layout are identical. The updated version/date stamp introduces no change to the scientific displays or their arrangement.

improvement.justification: v3 updates administrative version information and corrects an author's metadata spelling. The scientific content, evidence, explanations, reproducibility information, and visual presentation remain identical throughout the paper and appendices, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
